description: List the tags and notes the user logged in the Oura app (e.g. alcohol, caffeine, late meal, sickness, travel, custom tags) with their time, end time if any, and comments, merging classic and enhanced tags into one list sorted by time. Use it to explain unusual readiness or sleep, then cross-check the tagged days with get_daily_overview or get_trends. Range: the last 7 days by default; set start and end (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) or days (up to 400, ignored when start is set). Returns { records } oldest first, plus `unavailable` listing any data type the user didn't grant.

days.description: Shortcut for start: the last N days up to end. Ignored when start is set.

end.description: Last day to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

name: list_tags
title: List tags
